rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-18, CEILING-DOCUMENTATION confirmation probe (NOT a ceiling-raiser). Base = the iter-12 CHAMPION (SSIM 0.974822, PSNR 38.63 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300, seed=42). ONE KNOB CHANGED: val_n 16 -> 24 (isolated; a DIFFERENT, LARGER validation BASIS). EVERYTHING else identical to the iter-12 champion (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, seed=42; proj_sx/proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). WHY A VAL_N BASIS CHANGE IS THE HONEST PROBE NOW: ALL knob families are exhausted and characterized -- IMAGE-domain (range img_sr tight peak, depth img_n_bf=3 peak, kernel img_kernel 7->9 flat @iter-6, spatial img_sx/img_sy full 0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5 sweep flat) and PROJECTION-domain (range proj_sr=0.0005 peak / 0.0001 flat, depth proj_n_bf=2 flat, spatial proj_sx 1.0->0.5 DOWN @iter-14, proj_sy 2.0->0.5 flat @iter-15), plus n_iter (300->600 flat @iter-7) and pretrain_epochs. No ceiling-raiser remains. The SEED axis is already documented across THREE inits (iter-12 seed42 0.974822, iter-16 seed123 0.974834, iter-17 seed7 0.974843 -- a tight 3-seed cluster, range 2.1e-5). The COMPLEMENTARY honest confirmation is the VALIDATION BASIS: every iter so far scored the SAME 16 val scenes; widening to val_n=24 tests whether the 0.9748 ceiling is a property of the breast 128-view FBP substrate (it should hold on a LARGER, partially-DIFFERENT val subset) rather than an artefact of the particular 16-scene basis. HYPOTHESIS: val_n 16->24 lands SSIM at ~0.9748 (within +-0.0005 of the iter-12/16/17 cluster 0.974822 / 0.974834 / 0.974843). The 12-param bilateral is per-image self-supervised (each val scene fit on its OWN measurements, no shared model state), so adding 8 more independent breast scans should report the same per-scene FBP-bounded ceiling, CONFIRMING 0.9748 is a substrate property (breast 128-view FBP bound) not a small-val-set artefact. If instead SSIM swings by >0.0005, the 16-scene basis was unrepresentative and the ceiling read is val-set-dependent -- but per-image N2I scores each scene independently, so a tight reproduction on the larger basis is expected. WALL: per-image step budget scales 16->24 scenes (warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 24x300=7200 vs iter-12's 16x300=4800, +50%); iter-12 ran 497 s, iter-17 ran 488 s, so est ~720 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: val_n 16->24 (isolated).
